description:
Add Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool endpoints to any UWP app. zRover exposes input injection, screenshot capture, coordinate validation, and app-defined action dispatch tools through a FullTrust companion MCP server, letting AI agents interact with your app's UI.

New in 0.8.0: Low-level pointer tools — pointer_down, pointer_move, pointer_up — for stateful multi-finger touch and pen gestures spanning multiple MCP calls. Supports mixed touch+pen sessions.

New in 0.5.0: App Action API — implement IActionableApp to expose your own app's operations as list_actions / dispatch_action MCP tools.

Minimal integration: three lines in App.xaml.cs.
title: zRover - MCP Tools for UWP Apps
